cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.20%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.53%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.41%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.41%, GEV +5.32%, VRT +4.97%, AR +3.49%, DINO +3.45%. Laggards: EOSE -5.78%, SEDG -5.06%, ENPH -3.96%, RUN -3.83%.
